title: Skill or sugar pill?
budget_description: USD 400 admission budget; actual usage may overrun
max_usd_basis: Report 015 option 1 projection per attempt, times 1.5

routers.qualification: For find-skills, agent-browser, hyperframes and hyperframes-registry, these text tasks test the router's written response, not the delegated skill. Their results are excluded from verdict counts.
routers.headline: left out of the headline count

usage_profile.cache_creation: Not separately recorded. Included in normalized input_tokens. Cached tokens are a subset, never additive.
usage_profile.method: Lane maxima normalized to the older tokenizer, then scaled and rounded up for the selected model. Judge values are per-draw sample averages. Twice all input list rate; no cache discount. Historical token maxima are not a bound on future usage.

execution.next_run: reserve the attempt max_usd against the remaining cap before dispatch
execution.attempt_ceiling: stop an attempt at the first phase whose observed cost passes its max_usd
execution.continuation: one sealed receipt per attempt id across the manifest chain; an attempt without one is dispatched again, up to max_dispatches runs

assumptions.note: rough upper-bound estimate; registry per-MTok pricing; not measured with count_tokens
